profile.headline: SDE II at AWS
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Software engineer proficient in Java/Go backend, JS/React frontend and cloud automation to bring it all together.
I test new tech on my website all the time, check out www.gustavopflores.com

positions.title: Customer Engineer
positions.description:
•	Led technical discussions with clients on architecture redesign, migration planning, and Google Cloud best practices which have led to closing commitments up to $20M
•	Created internal tools and pipelines to make data driven decisions for client recommendations, resulting in better planning for existing/future products and higher consumption of GCP services
•	Led external facing webinars and projects for clients which increased GCP adoption and certificate acquisition

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Cloud Automation Engineer
positions.description:
Setup private instance of Terraform Enterprise utilizing AWS, Terraform, Okta and Docker
Assisted building new platform to enable self-service provisioning of AWS resources. Platform is written in Go and hosted in an EKS (Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service) cluster
Building custom Terraform provider to enforce governance and enhance existing Terraform resources with company specific configuration

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Part of Gartner's rotational program:
Full stack rotation - utilized Java, ReactJS and Oracle PL/SQL to create a web application to facilitate information creation/retrieval for the sales team.
DevOps rotation (AWS) - Enhanced application migration pipeline (ECS), architect and built Elastic MapReduce (EMR) platform/pipeline and upgraded numerous terraform modules (S3, IAM) to meet business needs.

positions.title: IS Intern
positions.description:
Developed two Android applications that communicated through a SQL database. Android apps automated third party registration and allowed security to validate registered users.
Continuously added new features to both applications as well as optimizing the SQL queries.
Upgraded, maintained network infrastructure and plant systems.

projects.title: Personal site
projects.description:
My personal website!
I use this platform to test frontend functionality that I come up with, experiment with different hosting methodology (AWS with S3/cloudfront, firebase), and learn how to improve SEO to drive traffic.

projects.title: Boa Vista BBQ
projects.description:
Designed and developed a website in JavaScript/React that is compatible with desktop and mobile devices for a local restaurant.
Responsible for UX/UI design, domain name, hosting and analytics.
Utilized Google analytics to drive website traffic, market to target audience, and increase business revenue.
